    When a user tries to access the system with PinCode: 1234
    Then the system should be available
    When a user tries to access the system with PinCode: 9999
    Then the system should be available
    When a user tries to access the system with PinCode: 1235
    Then the system should not be available

  Scenario: User login with valid credentials
    Given the system is configured with PinCodes: 1234, 5678, 9999
    And a user with username: user1 and password: pass123 exists
    When the user logs in with username: user1 and password: pass123
    Then the login should be successful
    And the user should be redirected to the dashboard

  Scenario: User login with invalid credentials
    Given the system is configured with PinCodes: 1234, 5678, 9999
    And a user with username: user1 and password: pass123 exists
    When the user logs in with username: user1 and password: wrongpass
    Then the login should fail
    And an error message "Invalid credentials" should be displayed

  Scenario: User registration
    Given the system is configured with PinCodes: 1234, 5678, 9999
    When a new user registers with username: user2 and password: pass456
    Then the user should be registered successfully
    And a unique patient ID should be generated

  Scenario: Patient requesting consultation
    Given the system is configured with PinCodes: 1234, 5678, 9999
    And a user with username: user1 and password: pass123 exists
    And a doctor with ID: 1001 exists and is linked to Speciality: Cardiology
    When the user requests a consultation for Speciality: Cardiology
    Then the consultation request should be successfully created
    And the doctor with ID: 1001 should receive the consultation request

    Given the system is configured with PinCodes: 1234, 5678, 9999
    And a doctor with ID: 1001 exists and is linked to Speciality: Cardiology
    And a patient with ID: 2001 exists
    When the doctor with ID: 1001 provides consultation to patient with ID: 2001
    Then the consultation should be successfully provided
    And the patient with ID: 2001 should receive the consultation
